steps.title: Demultiplex and Verify Reads
steps.instruction: Demultiplex Nanopore reads using LAST and verify the output files.

substeps.instruction: Demultiplex reads according to the 'Demultiplexing Nanopore reads with LAST' protocol.
Inspect the barcode_counts.txt file and delete unwanted barcodes (e.g., using cp barcode_counts.txt barcode_counts.orig.txt and nano barcode_counts.txt).
Verify that all demultiplexed files exist by running: for bc in $(awk '{print $2}' barcode_counts.txt); do ls demultiplexed/reads_${bc}.fq.gz; done

steps.title: Prepare Adapter FASTA File
steps.instruction: Prepare and index a FASTA file containing adapter sequences.

substeps.instruction: Set a shell variable for the filename: adapterFile="adapter_seqs.fa"

steps.title: Generate Substitution Matrix
steps.instruction: Create a substitution matrix (adapter.mat) for adapter mapping using last-train.

substeps.instruction: Run the following command using the first 10,000 reads from the full dataset: last-train -Q 1 -P 10 ${adapterFile} <(zcat reads_all.fastq.gz | head -n 40000) | tail -n 13
Alternatively, use the same matrix used during demultiplexing.

steps.title: Index Adapter File
steps.instruction: Create the LAST index for the adapter file using specific seeding and complexity settings.

steps.title: Map Reads in Split Mode
steps.instruction: Map reads to the adapter file using LAST in split mode with the pre-defined substitution matrix.

substeps.instruction: Execute the mapping across 10 processing threads (-P 10) for each barcode: for bc in $(awk '{print $2}' barcode_counts.txt); do echo "** ${bc} **"; lastal --split -P10 -p adapter.mat ${adapterFile} demultiplexed/adapter_assignments_${bc}.txt.gz done

steps.title: Filter and Orient Reads
steps.instruction: Filter adapter assignments to remove reads with multiple strand-switch primer matches and orient reads to match the original RNA strand.

substeps.instruction: Filter assignments through uniq, skipping the first field and matching up to 36 characters to exclude chimeric reads.
Group reads based on the mapped direction of the strand-switch primer.
Reverse-complement reads where necessary using fastx-fetch.pl and fastx-rc.pl scripts.
Create an output directory: mkdir -p oriented
Process each barcode: for bc in $(awk '{print $2}' barcode_counts.txt); do echo "** ${bc} **"; fastx-fetch.pl -i oriented/${bc}_reads_fwd.fq.gz; fastx-fetch.pl -i oriented/${bc}_reads_rev.fq.gz done

steps.title: Combine Oriented Sequences
steps.instruction: Merge forward and reverse-oriented sequences into a single group of RNA-oriented reads.

substeps.instruction: For each barcode, combine the files: for bc in $(awk '{print $2}' barcode_counts.txt); do echo "** ${bc} **"; pv oriented/${bc}_reads_fwd.fq.gz oriented/${bc}_reads_rev.fq.gz | zcat | gzip > oriented/${bc}_reads_dirAdjusted.fq.gz done
